blurb: Stillwater Stables provides programs for children ages 6-18 to develop relationships with horses, building trust, respect, confidence, and emotional awareness. Programs include group classes and one-on-one sessions focused on leadership, communication, and healing through horse interaction. The stable is a peaceful, natural environment dedicated to equine-assisted learning and character development.
